instruction.text: Decide if these statements about the internet are true or false.

atoms.a: The internet is a huge network connecting digital devices across the whole world.
Electricity for computers is made on the internet.
The abbreviation WWW stands for 'World Wide Web'.
You'll find the abbreviation WWW at the beginning of web addresses.

instruction.text: What can you do on the internet? Select all the correct answers.
How do you set up an internet connection at home? Put the steps in the correct order. Start with the first step at the top.

atoms.b: You get a contract with an internet provider.
A technician comes to your house and sets up the internet connection.
You connect your devices to the router through a Wi-Fi connection.
